_source: USCIS, Form I-589 page, 'Where to File with USCIS by Mail' (uscis.gov/i-589), page last updated 09/30/2026, read 2026-10-01. For an I-589 filed with USCIS on paper: by the state where the client lives. NOT for a client in immigration court (unless a UAC): that application goes to the court. The Asylum Intake Unit (3 Intake Way, Minneapolis, MN 55438-1455) takes only nunc pro tunc filings after losing derivative status. The attorney sets that address by hand.
